queries: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM `workspace`.`information_schema`.`columns` WHERE table_schema = 'default' AND table_name = 'bank_loan' ORDER BY ordinal_position

WITH base AS (SELECT `job` AS _k0, `id` AS _order, `age` AS _value FROM `workspace`.`default`.`bank_loan`),
quality AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN _k0 IS NULL OR _order IS NULL OR _value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing FROM base),
ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY _k0 ORDER BY _order DESC) AS _rank FROM base),
latest AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE _rank = 1),
key_counts AS (SELECT _k0, COUNT(*) AS n FROM latest GROUP BY _k0),
bounds AS (SELECT MIN(CAST(_value AS DOUBLE)) AS lo, MAX(CAST(_value AS DOUBLE)) AS hi FROM latest),
ranges AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lo = hi THEN lo - 0.5 ELSE lo END AS lo,
CASE WHEN lo = hi THEN hi + 0.5 ELSE hi END AS hi FROM bounds),
bucketed AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(_value AS DOUBLE) >= hi THEN 7
ELSE GREATEST(0, LEAST(7, CAST(FLOOR((CAST(_value AS DOUBLE)-lo)/NULLIF(hi-lo,0)*8) AS INT))) END AS bucket
FROM latest CROSS JOIN ranges),
frequencies AS (SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bucketed GROUP BY bucket),
bin_ids AS (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0,7)) AS bucket)
SELECT 0 AS __kind, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS __value, 0 AS __frequency,
n AS __input_rows, missing AS __null_rows,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM key_counts WHERE n > 1) AS __tied_keys,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM key_counts) AS __selected_keys,
8 AS __categories, (SELECT lo FROM ranges) AS __lower, (SELECT hi FROM ranges) AS __upper FROM quality
UNION ALL
SELECT 1, CAST(b.bucket AS STRING), COALESCE(f.n,0), 0,0,0,0,0,
r.lo+(r.hi-r.lo)*b.bucket/8, r.lo+(r.hi-r.lo)*(b.bucket+1)/8
FROM bin_ids b CROSS JOIN ranges r LEFT JOIN frequencies f ON b.bucket=f.bucket
ORDER BY __kind, __lower LIMIT 9

SELECT CAST(`age` AS STRING) AS category, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM (SELECT `age`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY `job` ORDER BY `id` DESC) AS rn FROM `workspace`.`default`.`bank_loan`) chosen WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY `age` ORDER BY category
